[LEARN]
insight: Database-level fixes require careful testing of edge cases - rate-limiting and deduplication logic needs to be verified against real production data patterns
context: When fixing cascading notification issues in PostgreSQL
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: Whitelist approach for audit systems is fragile - consider a more robust pattern like explicit allow-listing rather than trying to block-list exclude patterns
context: When audit systems have legitimate internal sources that get flagged
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: Clearing a backlog doesn't solve root cause - the 34 PAUSED tasks and self-review loop indicate the underlying architectural issues remain unaddressed
context: When doing triage-style fixes vs addressing systemic problems
[/LEARN]

[ISSUE]
insight: No tests existed for `request_inter_review` function - deduplication logic was added without test coverage
context: Database migration 027 and 056 applied without corresponding test additions
[/LEARN]

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
insight: Future database fixes should require accompanying test migrations to verify deduplication and rate-limiting logic
context: When implementing audit fixes in PostgreSQL triggers/functions
[/PROMPT_UPDATE]
